description:
Brand Introduction:

SAINT RIDGE is a conscious home goods brand that celebrates the artistry of traditional craftsmanship from around the globe. We offer a curated collection of handwoven, ethically sourced rugs that combine cultural heritage with modern design, providing timeless pieces that add warmth, style, and meaning to any space. With every order, we contribute to reforestation efforts by planting trees, and a portion of each purchase from our Moroccan Collection supports Project Soar, an organization empowering girls in Morocco.

Product Description:

Our collection features one-of-a-kind, handmade rugs crafted by skilled women artisans, using natural fibers and plant-based dyes. Each piece is a work of art that blends tradition and sustainability, offering unique designs that reflect the rich stories of the communities they come from. With a focus on quality and ethical sourcing, our rugs elevate any interior while making a positive social and environmental impact.

USP (Unique Selling Point):

  • Ethically Sourced & Artisan-Made: Partnering with global weaving cooperatives, our rugs are created through fair trade practices, empowering artisans and preserving traditional craft.
  • Sustainable & Charitable Impact: For every order, we plant trees to contribute to reforestation. Additionally, a portion of every purchase from our Moroccan Collection goes to Project Soar, supporting girls' empowerment in Morocco.
  • Handmade & Unique: Each rug is handcrafted, ensuring no two pieces are the same, making every rug a unique statement for any home.

Payment Terms:

Affiliates earn a competitive commission rate on each sale. Payment is issued monthly, with transparent tracking and reporting to ensure clarity and ease of use for all affiliates.

Other Information:

  • High AOV (Average Order Value): Our luxury home goods naturally attract higher AOV, leading to increased affiliate earnings.
  • Dedicated Support: Affiliates receive marketing assets, product information, and support to ensure successful promotions.
  • Target Audience: Home design enthusiasts, eco-conscious consumers, and those looking for high-quality, artisan-made products that reflect global culture and values.
